description: British star Adam Azim faces the biggest test of his career when he takes on Mexico?s Gabriel Gollaz Valenzuela in an IBF World Super Lightweight Title Eliminator on December 4, at the Copper Box Arena in London. The 24-year-old is on the brink of his first world title opportunity after a blistering third-round stoppage of Steve Claggett in May. Valenzuela, 32, from Guadalajara, has fought former world champion Subriel Matías and lost a controversial split decision to Lindolfo Delgado in another IBF eliminator. He has also won on British soil, beating Azim?s former stablemate Robbie Davies Jr in London in 2021 to claim the IBF International title. On the undercard, Francesca Hennessy faces France?s unbeaten Johanna Wonyou for the WBC Interim World Bantamweight Title. Unbeaten welterweights Elliot Whale and Bobby Faulkner meet for the WBA Continental title. Olympic bronze medallist Frazer Clarke returns, and unbeaten Hassan Azim, Adam?s older brother, takes on undefeated Ruben Torres.
